calls.reason: Verasight measures Altman favorability, and Morning Consult measures trust in AI CEOs generally. Neither establishes OpenAI distrust; the revenue report does not link business results to trust.

Co/efficient reports OpenAI net favorability of -41, while The Argument's poll reportedly finds +11 among those aware of it. These mixed favorability measures do not establish how few people trust OpenAI.
Contrary Research reports skepticism from some analysts but gives no count of reactions. That cannot establish near-universal disbelief, and Marcus frames the claim as his own impression.

Outlook Business and Enterprise report losses rising from $9.3 billion to $12.3 billion, about 32%. The Decoder corroborates the starting figure. The quarter-to-quarter comparison in context is far short of quadrupling.
